hypothesis: c025's cap of 15.68 is the strongest robust parent (robust +0.254, min +0.245); a modest x0.5 tightening to 7.84 was already tried (c024), so instead I fine-tune the *other* coefficient in the same mechanism — the momentum decay clamp — from 0.5 to 0.25 (x0.5), which makes the criticality signal even more responsive to the current placement so many moderately-critical nets keep weight (TNS) while the per-net cap stays at c025's proven 15.68.
analysis: The hypothesis held: tightening the momentum decay clamp to 0.25 while keeping c025's 15.68 cap improved all three cases (total +0.774, robust +0.215, min +0.205, all valid). Gains concentrate in dTNS (+28–42%) with smaller dWNS (+8–15%), consistent with the mechanism—more responsive criticality keeps moderately-critical nets weighted, improving TNS. Overflow rises modestly (~82–148). Next step: sweep the decay clamp between 0.25 and 0.5 (e.g., 0.35) to check for a monotonic trend and confirm 0.25 isn't past the optimum.
